text:
Anita: quick sync — we need to finalize pin metadata semantics so rollout logic is deterministic. proposing: pin_intent (policy), pin_affinity (placement hints), compatibility_group (semantic model id), fingerprint_prefix for exact-match detection, and a deterministic eviction_score for soft pins.
Devon: sounds good. small request: keep pin_intent enum tight: [hard, soft, staging, canary], no freeform.
Priya: agreed. eviction_score must be reproducible across processes. my draft: eviction_score = min(1.0, (pressure_weight * cluster_pressure) + (age_ms / max(grace_window_ms,1))). pressure_weight in [0,1]. we can tune.
Marco: ops concern: need safety_label to opt pins out of automated eviction (values: customer_critical, internal_test, ephemeral). will block backfill for customer_critical.
Anita: telemetry_tags are useful but must be bounded. propose per-tenant allowlist of tag keys, max 3 tags, values limited to 32 chars and tokenized (no spaces). enforce at ingestion.
Devon: on model identity: compatibility_group should be primary for fallback decisions. fingerprint_prefix (8 hex chars) for exact-match short-circuit. if compatibility differs, skip variant unless explicit override.
Priya: sample public schema we can expose to SDKs: 
"pin_hint:release-2026-03, pin_intent:soft, pin_affinity:[region:us-east-1,rack:A], grace_window_ms:600000, telemetry_tags:[cohort:alpha,stage:preprod], compatibility_group:gpt-small-v2, fingerprint_prefix:abcd1234, fallback_order:[variant-v2-q4,variant-v2-fp16]"
Marco: internal-only fields: lease_token, last_renewed_ms, computed_eviction_score. clients must never receive lease_token.
Anita: migration plan: 1) server reads both old+new fields for 21 days, 2) backfill compatibility_group using model registry metadata, 3) write new pins with both shapes during window, 4) enable enforcement after canary.
Devon: add safety: backfill job should skip any pin with safety_label=customer_critical and emit an alert if skipped_count > 0.5% of tenant pins.
Priya: telemetry: emit pin_transition events with fields (tenant, route, pin_intent, safety_label, bounded telemetry_tags). add histograms for pin_eviction_latency and pin_bind_time.
Marco: ops: reserve 2h migration window and pick 5 canary tenants. rollback: reapply snapshot and pause backfill. also coordinate with release team for canary deploys.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4003: pin-metadata-migration -> https://phabricator.redwood/INF-4003
Anita: compatibility notes: document fingerprint_prefix length and collision risk. recommend 8 hex chars; add a compatibility check endpoint SDKs can call to verify a candidate fallback variant.
Devon: i'll open schema PR with public/internal split, enum constraints, compatibility_group, fingerprint_prefix, and telemetry tag limits. include compatibility-check endpoint spec.
Priya: i'll add eviction_score unit tests and a sim script to show sensitivity across pressure and age.
Marco: i'll prepare ops playbook, canary tenant list, and alerting thresholds.
Anita: final doc blurb we should publish: "hard = pinned, non-evictable; soft = eligible after grace_window_ms and when eviction_score crosses threshold; staging = prefer staging pool; canary = small traffic slice routing." include telemetry tags policy.
Devon: will add examples for fallback_order + compatibility_group interactions in PR.
Anita: thanks all — aim to have PR + playbook ready by end of week.
ops-bot: linked INF-4003 -> DEPLOY-321 for canary coordination
